record: Recorded provider evidence for the Bright Data adapter tests
retention: Aggregate and field-presence evidence only. No row-level job data, no credential, and no response payload were retained by the observation, so no file in this directory contains provider bytes.
reconstruction: The snapshot records below are a deterministic reconstruction constrained by the recorded facts in this file. They are not captured provider output. Nothing in them is a real listing, a real employer, or a real person, and no digest in this directory reproduces the digests the observation recorded.

request_of_record.custom_output_fields: 13 issue fields, pipe separated, sent on the query string and in the body

submission.note: The handoff happened inside the documented one-minute synchronous limit, so elapsed time does not predict the response shape. Only the status code does.

handoff.message: Snapshot is not ready yet, try again in 30s

field_presence_matrix.note: Transcribed from the observation. Ten records, all thirteen requested fields inspected in every record. No requested field was absent as a key, and no field was dropped by the selector.

url.extra: every value is on the www.linkedin.com host

job_location.extra: mentions the requested city in 10 of 10

apply_link.extra: a provider assertion that no value exists, not a closed or expired listing

country_code.extra: null despite an exactly echoed country filter, so it carries no country evidence and must never be back-filled from the request

discovery_input.extra: the five submitted filters round-tripped exactly and the five omitted filters came back as empty strings; jobs_to_not_include has no echo member at all

application_availability.extra: true in all 10 records, beside an explicitly null apply_link

job_posted_time.extra: the relative ago pattern in all 10 records

terminal_completeness.consequence: Nothing in the observed state separates a provider that found exactly ten from one that found more and stopped at the cap, so no coverage or completeness claim is representable.
